title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Detention Day Rates for Reefer-Class Equipment
content:
Reference amounts for a detention day priced at reefer-class rates on a Demurrage and Detention Free Time record, in US dollars per container.

| Slab of the day | AHL Tariff Free Time | AHL Free Time Extension 3 | AHL Free Time Extension 7 | AHL Combined Free Time 14 | AHL Combined Free Time 21 | AHL Contract Free Time 30 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Slab 1 | 120.00 | 120.00 | 120.00 | 120.00 | 120.00 | 96.00 |
| Slab 2 | 180.00 | 180.00 | 180.00 | 180.00 | 180.00 | 144.00 |
| Slab 3 | 260.00 | 260.00 | 260.00 | 260.00 | 260.00 | 208.00 |
| Slab 4 | 340.00 | 340.00 | 340.00 | 340.00 | 340.00 | 272.00 |

## Notes on the table

- Reading across a row shows that the daily figure for a given slab is uniform across the tariff, extension and combined products and lower only for the contract product.
- Reading down a column shows the escalation from the first slab to the fourth for one product.

Hypothetical illustration: three reefer detention days, all in slab 2, under AHL Free Time Extension 3 total 540.00.
